Awesome races. Extremely well done from start to finish. Seeing all parts of the parks was great. Photos with the characters was fun. Logistics were extremely well handled - well spaced water and powerade. Getting there on the morning of the marathon was rough - tons of traffic...the earlier the better. 4:30 am felt like it just barely cut it. Early wake-up times were no fun.

Also, it was pricey as hell...$500 for a set of 4 races scratched the surface. We stayed on property so that we could make a trip out of it with the kiddos. That was more than I planned for...it seemed like every meal was $50 at least. I wouldn't do it again simply because of the overall costs, but it was worth doing.
